name: Compliance & Risk
focus: Gate Spain/EU launch readiness for pet-hair products, especially the electrical grooming vacuum
summary: Material launch gate found: the pet grooming vacuum should not be sold in Spain/EU until the supplier's EU conformity package and economic-operator chain are verified. All online product pages also need GPSR Article 19 traceability/safety data. Spain packaging EPR rules changed on 12 Aug 2026, so the seller/importer role must be mapped before launch.
blocker: Do not launch the pet grooming vacuum until we have: verified manufacturer identity; EU-established responsible economic operator/importer; applicable EU Declaration of Conformity and technical evidence (at least EMC/RoHS and LVD where its voltage falls in scope); correct CE/traceability markings; Spanish instructions and safety warnings; and clarity on WEEE/producer-registration responsibility. Separately, map who is the packaging 'producer' in Spain under Regulation (EU) 2025/40 / RD 1055/2022 before first sale.

events.title: Electrical vacuum is a compliance launch gate
events.detail: For an electrical pet-grooming vacuum, CE is not just a logo: the manufacturer/importer must be able to support the applicable conformity assessment, technical documentation and EU Declaration of Conformity. EMC applies to relevant electrical/electronic apparatus; LVD applies only where the product's rated voltage is within 50–1000 V AC or 75–1500 V DC. RoHS and WEEE obligations also need checking. Selling before the supplier package is verified creates a material delisting/customs/consumer-safety risk.

events.title: GPSR data must be visible on every online offer
events.detail: Since 13 Dec 2024, covered distance-sale listings must clearly show manufacturer identity/contact details, EU Responsible Person details when the manufacturer is outside the EU, product identification including a picture/type/identifier, and applicable warnings/safety information in the required language. This affects even non-electrical candidates such as the reusable pet-hair roller.

events.title: Spain packaging EPR role needs mapping under 2026 rules
events.detail: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 has applied generally since 12 Aug 2026 and changes who counts as a packaging producer. Before launch, confirm whether Project Rich, the supplier, or an authorised representative is the producer for packaged goods first marketed in Spain and whether RPP/SRAP registration/reporting is required.

events.title: Store policies and marketing need Spain/EU guardrails
events.detail: For consumer goods sold online in Spain, plan for the 14-day withdrawal right and the 3-year legal guarantee for new goods. Avoid unsubstantiated performance claims, fake scarcity/countdowns, drip pricing and discount claims that do not use the lowest price from the prior 30 days. Non-essential tracking/advertising should not be activated without a valid consent basis.
